teaching_moments.title: Phase 2: CRM & Planka Board Sync
teaching_moments.explanation: When dealing with inbound leads, never manually manage state. Always pipe clean webhook data directly into Planka boards via the `planka_create_card` and `planka_move_card` tools. Use UUIDs as card titles or references to sync external Database records.
teaching_moments.visual_mermaid:
graph TD
    A[Inbound Webhook] --> B{Clean Data}
    B -->|Valid| C[Create DB Row UUID]
    C --> D[Planka Create Card]
    D --> E[Move Card based on State]
    B -->|Invalid| F[Error Trigger Node]

teaching_moments.title: The Orchestrate Tool & Heavy Workflows
teaching_moments.explanation: Heavy tasks like `design_ui`, `research_implement`, and `code_review` should never block your immediate response loop. Call the `orchestrate` MCP tool to dispatch the task to a background Kenbun Swarm. It returns a Job ID immediately. You can poll `orchestrate_status()` later, ensuring the operator never experiences a frozen UI.
teaching_moments.visual_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Operator
    participant Antigravity
    participant Kenbun_Swarm
    Operator->>Antigravity: 'Build a new dashboard'
    Antigravity->>Kenbun_Swarm: orchestrate(workflow: 'design_ui')
    Kenbun_Swarm-->>Antigravity: Returns Job ID
    Antigravity-->>Operator: 'Job started. Proceeding with other tasks.'
    Antigravity->>Kenbun_Swarm: orchestrate_status(Job ID)
    Kenbun_Swarm-->>Antigravity: Status: Complete

teaching_moments.title: Zero-Error Pre-Flight Sentinel
teaching_moments.explanation: Never mark a task complete without executing `console-sentinel`. The standard demands 0 console errors, 0 SSR hydration mismatches, and 0 database statement timeouts. Catching it before the operator sees it is what separates a junior script from a Senior System 3 Swarm.
teaching_moments.visual_mermaid:
graph LR
    A[Code Changes Done] --> B[Run console-sentinel]
    B --> C{Errors Found?}
    C -->|Yes| D[Autonomous Auto-Fix Loop]
    D --> B
    C -->|No| E[Mark Task Complete]

teaching_moments.title: Defensive Integration & Reconciliation
teaching_moments.explanation: Never assume an external ID (like an ElevenLabs Agent ID) belongs to your active tenant. Always cross-reference your local DB (`matched`, `unimportedRemote`, `crossAccountErrors`). If it fails, wrap it in a non-blocking UI modal with a deep-link to the official docs.
teaching_moments.visual_mermaid:
graph TD
    A[Fetch Remote API] --> B{Match Local DB?}
    B -->|Yes| C[Render Dashboard]
    B -->|No - Missing DB| D[Flag as unimportedRemote]
    B -->|No - 401/404| E[Flag as crossAccountErrors]
    E --> F[Render Warning Modal + Docs Link]

teaching_moments.title: The Feedback Action Dispatcher & Claude 3.5 Calibration Brain
teaching_moments.concept: Surgical In-Place Prompt Calibration & Evaluation Synthesis
teaching_moments.explanation: When operator critiques or call transcripts arrive, never rewrite prompts from scratch or copy-paste raw user words. Dispatch the exact 3-layer payload to Claude 3.5 Sonnet using enforced tool-calling (`record_diagnosis`). Claude locates the exact anchor paragraph, embeds a surgical in-place patch, and synthesizes 1..N objective binary evaluation criteria.
teaching_moments.visual_mermaid:
sequenceDiagram
    participant Operator as Operator / Webhook
    participant Server as Server Action (feedback-actions)
    participant Claude as Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Tool Use)
    participant DB as PostgreSQL (prompt_revisions)
    participant ElevenLabs as ElevenLabs API
    Operator->>Server: Submit Directive ('Bands on website now')
    Server->>Claude: Dispatch System + Current Prompt + Directive
    Claude-->>Server: Returns In-Place Diff + Eval Criteria Suite
    Server->>DB: Store Pending Revision & Criteria Array
    Operator->>Server: Click 'Approve & Deploy'
    Server->>ElevenLabs: PATCH conversation_config.agent.prompt.prompt & Append Criteria
